dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: With the permission of Guuji Yae Miko, the Grand Narukami Shrine will provide help to those businesses and families affected by the war in the form of aid loans and food aid.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: We ask that those in need of help visit the Kamisato Clan to file the required paperwork.

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: As the war continues and public funds become more tight, food aid will be reduced by half. We apologize for any inconvenience.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I'd just like to say a big thank you to Lady Yae and the Yashiro Commissioner for their consideration. It's just that there are way too many people here everyday for food aid..."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "People are not receiving the daily allotment of food aid that they are supposed to. What should we do..."

dialogues.speaker: Grand Narukami Shrine Notice
dialogues.text: I am sorry, but we don't have a better way. Lady Yae and the Commissioner are doing their best to handle the situation.
